body: 2026-10-14 (dd923c0). ci.yml runs `task check` + golangci-lint on push/PR to main; release.yml runs on a v* tag push (go test -race, then ubgo/volt-action with volt pinned, `volt release --from-tag`), skips a tag that already has a release, and a manual run republishes with clobber. Why: agx is public so Actions minutes are free (the owner's no-metered-CI rule targets private repos), and a laptop release had sat behind testlock. Check a run once with `gh run view`, never `gh run watch`.
title: CI and releases run on GitHub Actions (public repo)
